## Summary

It lands between algrowth and sofar-cloud and well below brillo, so sofar is a mid-weight host rather than the expensive one its 36 percent share suggested. The floor is now 264 of 300 P sessions priced at 4,549.56 dollars, bracketing to 4,807-5,413 against the 4,163-6,588 stated at the freeze — the range narrows and its low end is gone, since that bracket had assumed the unpriced hosts might be as cheap as algrowth.
